long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I am already beside the workbench, so I may as well stay here and look like I planned it.
Its flat top has been claimed by nobody, which is a problem I intend to solve.
The clay bank is near enough that I should go and see what it is doing.
A piece of clay is a thing worth keeping, and I keep things.
Storage at home is where good things belong, and I am not giving this one back.
A warm patch of sun is owed to me after all that wandering.

today.reason: I will claim the workbench, collect some clay, and then nap somewhere warm before the evening comes.
